title: Custom PCR Preparation for 384-Well qPCR Plates
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Specify plate count
steps.instruction: Prepare the protocol to run on up to six 384‑well qPCR plates.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select your labware files with a .json extension (if needed).

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: Upload your protocol file (with a .py extension) to the OT App on the Protocol tab.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate your labware, tiprack, and pipette using the OT App. Refer to the support articles for calibration tips if needed.
